newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Central Parking squeezes SunTrust for $150 mln.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Central Parking squeezes SunTrust for $150 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Dec 18 (LPC) - Central Parking Corp has tapped SunTrust Banks Inc for a $150 million bank loan backing its acquisitions of Square Industries Inc and four additional parking garages in the St. Louis area, according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing.
The credit is structured as an unsecured, reducing revolver that expires January 31, 2000, and the loans maturity can be extended one year, upon request of the parent, according to the filing.

Pricing is 150 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR) until the earlier of the sale of certain assets or April 30, 1997, at which point pricing is tied either to financial yardsticks or Central Parking's senior, unsecured debt rating, the filing said.
